lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Mariana Bah is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Mariana is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d40: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
d40: 🕯️ Mariana Bah is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Mariana kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Mariana's gone." Catalina looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Mariana." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Miguel blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d40: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Stalk (Level 1). Move unseen. Close distance without being noticed.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Mariana Bah, 40 days. The mantle passes to Miguel Salas.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Miguel Salas, 33 — a Veterinarian. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Lucky Rock, Green Whisper, Bloodhound, Trophy Room.
d40: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Mariana — and Mariana is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Sari, Catalina, Tashi and 3 more speak for Miguel — "Mariana trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Miguel before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
d64: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Miguel Salas is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d64: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
